steps.en: The system returns success or failure for every notice.
steps.id: Sistem mengembalikan berhasil atau gagal untuk tiap notice.

steps.en: A failed notice comes with the reason it failed.
steps.id: Notice yang gagal disertai alasan kegagalannya.

steps.en: A success message shows how many notices were suspended.
steps.id: Pesan berhasil menampilkan jumlah notice yang disuspensi.

steps.en: A failure message and a list show each failed notice with its reason.
steps.id: Pesan gagal dan daftar menampilkan tiap notice gagal beserta alasannya.

steps.en: On a system error or timeout the officer is told it failed.
steps.id: Saat error sistem atau timeout, officer diberi tahu bahwa gagal.
steps.why_en: After a timeout the portal may mark notices as failed although the suspension was already applied.
steps.why_id: Setelah timeout, portal bisa menandai notice gagal padahal suspensinya sudah diterapkan.
